latest_release.name: Concat v0.2.10
latest_release.body:
## Concat 0.2.10

### Fixed

- **Captions on Windows.** Generating captions no longer closes the app as it starts (#667, #668, #673).
- **Black preview with Chroma Key.** On some Windows PCs the Chroma Key effect could leave every preview black and exports failing. That cause is fixed (#673). A black preview that has nothing to do with Chroma Key is still open; if you see one on 0.2.10, please add your log to #709.
- When the graphics driver drops out mid-session, Concat notices straight away and tries again every two seconds, not on every frame (#673).
- Titles, captions and shapes play their In, Out and Loop animations, and an animation picked in the Animate panel sticks (#369).
- A speed curve plays smoothly, without a stutter every tenth of a second.
- The Library's sidebar scrolls, so Audio Effects can be reached under Video Effects.
- The New Project sheet scrolls in a short window and its shapes wrap in a narrow one (#688, #689, #693).
- The missing media dialog fits its files, closes from its ×, and each missing file has a Remove.
- The inspector keeps Voice only and No voice (#120).

### New

- **In, Out and Loop animations** for clips, pictures, titles and shapes, picked from a wall of cards that play their moves (#369).
- **Voice isolation.** Keep a clip's voice alone or take it out, from a song's music or a recording's noise, each part at its own level (#120).
- **Shake & Motion.** Shake, Impact, Beat Shake and Prism Shake on a shelf of their own.
- **A stack of masks per clip**, each with its own mode and keyframes (#489).
- **Shapes you can edit**: size, corners, polygons, stars, gradients, outlines, line ends, trim and shadow (#288).
- Fades follow a curve you can hear and see, with a red zone on the fader and every waveform.
- The speed curve graph is taller, sits on a labelled grid, and lets you pick several points at once.
- Caption language presets for Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Persian, Urdu, Hindi, Bengali, Thai, Vietnamese, Russian, Ukrainian and Greek (#675).
- Generate Captions lives in the Library, under Text & Captions.
- Your computer stays awake, and your phone's screen stays on, while a job runs (#695).
- Enhance takes any scale up to 2K, shows a progress bar, and says what it will make before it starts.
- A setting that only takes effect at launch offers a restart, which saves and reopens your project.
- The panels and the window open where you left them.

### Faster

- Titles and captions no longer freeze the window: they are painted in the background, about 45 times faster than before (#261).
- Effects are ready when the window opens, so the first time you use one it does not stall.
- Exports read each clip ahead of its cut.
- Filmstrips of long footage appear sooner.

### Interface

- A new Welcome screen, with a What's new card.
- The Audio tab is rebuilt around a gain fader, a stem mixer and fades drawn on the sound (#120).
- Settings is a page over the whole window, as Export is.
- Layers, effects, grades and transitions each have a colour of their own.
- OK comes before Cancel on Windows, and after it on macOS and Linux (#681).
- Dragging past the timeline's edge scrolls gently or fast depending on how far you go, and the scrollbar is bigger (#633, #634).
- Fourteen looks have new names.

### For agents and scripts

- `concat --schema` prints the whole API as JSON Schema.
- An agent can give a clip a stack of masks and keyframe each one.
- `concat preview` draws an effect at any instant of its clip (`--moment`) and a transition at any point of its cut (`--progress`).
- If a graphics driver misreports its memory, `CONCAT_GPU_BUDGET=off` lifts the limit Concat sets from it.

### Before you install

- **Windows:** this release is not code-signed yet. SmartScreen asks before it runs: **More info** › **Run anyway**. Where Smart App Control is on, Windows refuses unsigned programs; see the [code signing policy](https://github.com/jub0t/concat/blob/main/CODE_SIGNING.md).
- **Android:** no automated

The free, open-source, cross-platform video editor.

## About Concat is a free, open-source video editor for macOS, Windows, Linux and Android. It covers what most edits need: auto-captions, text-to-speech, background removal, keyframe animation, effects and titles, multi-track cutting, 4K export. With none of the catches: no watermark, no account, no subscription, no upload. Everything runs on your machine. Install it, drop in footage, cut. The AI models for captions, voices and cutout download once from Settings and work offline after that. Your footage never leaves your disk. **Good for:** TikTok, Reels and Shorts, YouTube videos, tutorials and screen recordings, podcast clips, memes. **Also for machines:** a built-in MCP server for AI agents (`concat --mcp`, [set up](docs/MCP.md)) and a JSON-RPC API for scripts, so they can cut video with it too. ## Highlights - 🚫 **No watermarks. No account. No paywall.** Ever. - 🔒 **100% local.** Nothing uploads. Works offline. - 💬 **Auto-captions.** Made on your machine. Pick a model size, get styled captions on the timeline. - 🗣️ **Text-to-speech + voice cloning.** A free local voice on the desktop, or any voice from a few seconds of a recording. Phones are getting their own system voice. - 🧍 **Background removal.** People, objects, or paint the mask yourself. - 🎞️ **Keyframes.** Position, scale, rotation, opacity, volume, effect parameters. Curve editor built in. - ✨ **100 effects, filters and transitions.** Live in the preview. - ✂️ **Cut fast.** Split, trim, ripple, merge, freeze frame, speed. Magnetic timeline if you want it. - 🎚️ **Multi-track, multi-timeline.** Overlays and picture-in-picture: stack video, stills and titles on as many tracks as you like. Several cuts in one project. Blend modes (screen, add, multiply…), crop, flips. - 📝 **Titles.** Fonts, stroke, shadow, background plate. Presets to start from. - 🎙️ **One-switch voice cleanup.** Denoise, enhance voice, level the loudness. Plus chipmunk, robot, telephone and friends. - 📤 **Export.** H.264, HEVC, AV1. Up to 4K 60, 10-bit colour. - ⚡ **Fast.** Proxies built in, so 4K scrubs smoothly. - 🤖 **Scriptable.** An MCP server built in, so Claude and other AI agents can edit with it ([one line to set up](docs/MCP.md)), and a JSON-RPC API for scripts. A build from source adds gRPC and a command-line tool. - 🖥️ **macOS, Windows, Linux, Android.** 26 languages. Same app, same project files. ## Download Two ways in: 1. **[The website](https://concat.standalones.org/#download)** hands you the right build for your machine. Start here. 2. **[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/jub0t/Concat/releases)** has every build for every platform, with installers, packages and checksums. For when you want to pick. Concat is in **beta**: it works, and it still has edges. [Say so](https://github.com/jub0t/Concat/issues) when you find one. **Platforms** - ✅ **Windows** · x86_64 (ARM builds are paused, see [#326](https://github.com/jub0t/Concat/issues/326)). A setup and an `.msi`. If SmartScreen stops an unsigned build: **More info** › **Run anyway** - ✅ **macOS** · Intel and Apple silicon. If macOS refuses to open an unsigned build: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Concat.app` - ✅ **Linux** · x86_64 and ARM. `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.AppImage` and an Arch package. Also a Flatpak on **[Flatpark](https://flatpark.org/apps/app.concat.editor/)**, a community Flatpak remote that wraps the x86_64 `.deb` of each release and updates with it - ✅ **Android** · phones and tablets - ✅ **iOS / iPadOS** · iPhone and iPad, sideloaded ✅ Supported · 🚧 Work in progress · 🧪 To be tested **System requirements** and the optional model sizes are on [the website](https://concat.standalones.org/guides/system-requirements). **[Code signing policy](CODE_SIGNING.md)**: why the Windows builds are not signed yet, and what Concat sends over the network (nothing you did not ask for). ## Build from source You need Rust 1.93 or newer (see `rust-version` in `src/Cargo.toml`), the FFmpeg 7+ development libraries, cmake and a C++ compiler. - **macOS:** `brew install ffmpeg` - **Windows:** from [FFmpeg's Windows downloads](https://ffmpeg.org/download.html#build-windows), take BtbN's `win64-gpl-shared` build (the one CI uses), unpack it and point `FFMPEG_DIR` at it - **Linux:** use your distro's FFmpeg if it is version 7 or newer, otherwise use a BtbN `shared` build with `FFMPEG_DIR` like on Windows Then: ```sh cd src cargo run -p concat # the editor window ``` Other useful commands: ```sh cargo build --profile app -p concat # the shipping binary (fat LTO, stripped) cargo test # run the test suite cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings # what CI checks ``` If you change text the interface shows, run `python3 scripts/locales.py` from the repo root so the string inventory stays in sync. Full details live in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## How to Contribute > [!IMPORTANT] > The best way to contribute is to grab a build from the [Releases](https://github.com/jub0t/Concat/releases) page and use it: find where it breaks, and say where it could be better. > > Ready to write code? [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) covers setup, the layout of the tree, the checks to run, and how contributions are licensed. Driving Concat from a script, a service or an agent? [The developer docs](https://concat.standalones.org/docs) cover the Concat API and its transports: JSON-RPC and gRPC; [docs/MCP.md](docs/MCP.md) connects an AI agent over MCP. [This Discussion](https://github.com/jub0t/Concat/discussions/3) is where the project was announced. > > Contributors can claim a `@Contributor` role in the Discord server: just ask. ## Star History ## Contributors ## Licence Concat is free software under [AGPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSE). A commercial licence is available for closed-source use; see [LICENSING.md](LICENSING.md). ## DMCA If you believe something in this repository, its releases, or a package or model it distributes infringes your copyright, email [jub0trd@gmail.com](mailto:jub0trd@gmail.com) with a description of the work you own, a link to where the infringing material appears here, your contact details, a statement that you believe in good faith the use is not authorised by you, your agent, or the law, and a statement, under penalty of perjury, that the notice is accurate and that you are the owner or authorised to act for the owner, signed with your physical or electronic signature; valid notices are acted on promptly, and anyone whose material is removed may send a counter-notice to the same address.
